finding.headline: "The Stomach-Tying Torn Mum"
finding.problem: "My mum says tie my stomach but I had a CS — is binding safe? And what do I wear over it?"
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "The postpartum wardrobe gap between maternity clothes and your old wardrobe"
finding.person: African mum pressured by omugwo tradition to bind stomach (wrapper/waist trainer) but scared of C-section scar; wants informed choice (TheWill: stomach-tying; skabash: not for C-section).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (belly-binding informed choice + flattering clothing) — uniquely African". Verdict: PASSES.
